what_it_does: Addresses the cryptography transition challenge as quantum computers threaten existing encryption standards. Current protocols like RSA will become insecure when powerful quantum computers arrive; post-quantum cryptography (encryption algorithms believed safe against quantum attacks) must be deployed widely. The paper introduces Quartz, a tool for discovering which parts of computing systems still use vulnerable cryptography by mapping dependencies between encryption algorithms across software and hardware components. A Cryptography Bill of Materials provides visibility into quantum security risk exposure.
